title: 1 Nuke vs 100 Pawns
summary: Tony's king plus one Nuke ('moves like every chess piece combined' = queen + knight) vs Martin's king and a solid 5x20 brick of 100 pawns on a ~20-wide board. He centralizes the nuke and snipes pawns that walk into its lines, creating 'Swiss cheese holes', fears protected pawn chains marching to promotion, hangs out on the right flank picking off pawns, and finally mates Martin with a knight-style check (~8:11).
rules: Board enlarged to about 20 files x 10 ranks (frame count approximate).
Black: king + 100 pawns as a solid brick 5 ranks deep x 20 files wide.
Nuke moves like every chess piece combined: queen + knight (amazon-style). (Contrast: the later Yp7AnbFcgHI video's nuke is queen + knightrider.)
Pawns move normally (double-step from start, promote).
win_condition: Checkmate Martin's king before a pawn promotes into a mating force (won).

board.theme_notes: chess.com green; Nuke shown as a white missile icon

setup: Black king top centre; black pawns fill a 5x20 block in front of it; White king + Nuke at the bottom with open space in front (pawns start on their own side and may double-step).
visual_fx: legal-move dots across the board when Nuke selected
current_impl_issues: Impl approximates with 3 full ranks of pawns on 8x8; video is a 5x20 brick on a ~20-wide board.
Impl nuke = queen + knightrider; in THIS video it is queen + knight.
